claim: Saint-Malo ramparts form a free walking loop of about 2 km taking roughly 1 hour, with recommended start at Porte Saint-Thomas behind Place Chateaubriand and staircases at each gate (Saint-Vincent, Dinan, Grand'Porte).
quote: The high wall that surrounds the city of Saint-Malo forms a loop about two kilometres. Allow around 1 hour for a complete tour... start by taking the Porte Saint-Thomas, located behind the Place Chateaubriand.

claim: Fort National opens daily 1 June–30 September plus Easter and All Saints school holidays and long weekends (1 May, 8 May, Ascension, Whitsun); access is tide-dependent on foot from Plage de l'Éventail when the French flag is hoisted.
quote: open... during school holidays (Easter and All Saints Day), long weekends (Labour Day, 8th of May, Ascension, Whit Sunday) and every day from June 1st to September 30th... The Fort opening times depend on the tides and change each day.

claim: Fort National admission is €5 adult and €3 child (6–16), free under 6, with student/large-family/unemployed discounts; tickets sold at the gate.
quote: Adults €5, Children (6-16 years) €3-4, and free for children under 6, with discounts available for students, large families, and unemployed visitors.

claim: Grand Aquarium de Saint-Malo 2026 tickets are €19.90 adult (13+) and €15.90 child (4–12), free under 4, with the Nautibus and Abyssal Descender rides included.
quote: Billet Adulte (13+ ans) : 19,90 € et Billet Enfant (4-12 ans) : 15,90 €... L'accès aux 2 attractions « Nautibus » et « Abyssal Descender » est inclus.

claim: The Grand Aquarium is at Avenue du Général Patton in the La Madeleine district about 6 km south of intra-muros, reachable by bus line 1 in ~21 minutes; May–June hours are 10h–19h daily.
quote: Avenue du Général Patton, 35400 Saint-Malo... Mai & Juin 2026 : tous les jours de 10h à 19h

claim: Demeure de Corsaire (Hôtel Magon de la Lande) is visitable by guided tour only — daily at 15h outside school holidays (closed Monday) and 10h–11h30 + 14h30–17h during holidays — at €8.50 adult / €6 reduced.
quote: Daily from 10h to 11h30 and from 14h30 to 17h00 [holidays]... Daily at 15h (closed on Monday) [outside holidays]. Adult admission: €8.50; reduced €6.

claim: Cathédrale Saint-Vincent on Place Jean de Châtillon is open daily 9h–18h30 with free entry, blending Romanesque and Gothic styles and housing the tombs of Jacques Cartier and Duguay-Trouin plus a grand rose window.
quote: Open daily: 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM... Romanesque and Gothic styles... Tombs of Jacques Cartier and Duguay-Trouin... Grand rose window.

claim: Plage de Bon-Secours sits inside the ramparts at Place du Guet and has a 1937 tidal seawater swimming pool with diving board, refilled twice daily by the tide and lifeguarded in summer.
quote: accessible via the ramparts and the fortified town... seawater swimming pool... renewed twice a day, at each tide... equipped with a diving board.

claim: Plage du Sillon is Saint-Malo's largest beach, stretching ~3 km from Pointe de Rochebonne to the edge of intra-muros, favoured for sand-yachting, kitesurfing and long walks rather than calm-water swimming.
quote: Stretching over 3 kilometres, Plage du Sillon is the largest beach in Saint-Malo... perfect for water sports enthusiasts: sand yachting, kitesurfing, windsurfing.

claim: Chateaubriand's tomb sits on the islet of Grand Bé ~400 m off the ramparts and is reachable on foot from Plage de Bon-Secours only at low tide — roughly 1h30 before to 1h30 after low water, with Saint-Malo's >12 m spring tidal range making the window dangerous to misjudge.
quote: Grand Bé est une île... 400 mètres au nord-ouest de Saint-Malo... accessible uniquement à marée basse... le passage est généralement possible environ 1h30 avant et 1h30 après l'heure de la basse mer.

claim: Fort du Petit Bé, the neighbouring Vauban islet fort, runs 30-minute guided tours 11h–18h tide-permitting at €5 adult / €4 child 6–12, free under 7, with on-foot or ferry access.
quote: guided tour lasts approximately thirty minutes... adults pay €5... children aged 6-12 at €4... open for guided tours between 11am and 6pm when weather permits.

claim: Drivers should park outside the walls at Esplanade Saint-Vincent (P5, underground at the main gate, 24/7, EV charging), Duguay-Trouin (P1, open-air on the quay near Plage du Sillon), Bourse (P2, by Porte de Dinan) or the free Rocabey lot 15–20 minutes' walk out.
quote: Esplanade Saint-Vincent (P5)... tout proche de la grande Porte de Saint-Malo Intra-Muros... Duguay Trouin (P1)... Rocabey (Free)... 15-20 minutes' walk from the ramparts.

claim: Cancale's Marché aux Huîtres operates daily with 8 independent producers; spring/summer hours 9am-7pm (8pm in July-August), autumn/winter 9-9:30am to 5:30pm, located at Rue des Parcs - Le Port near Pointe des Crolles.
quote: Spring/Summer: Daily: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Extended to 8:00 PM in July-August. The market features 8 independent oyster producers. Rue des Parcs - Le Port, 35260 Cancale

claim: A dozen huîtres creuses at the Cancale market costs roughly 6-10€ (caliber 3 around 6-8€, smaller calibers up to 7.50€), with flat oysters (Belon) and special selections like Tsarskaya priced higher.
quote: la douzaine d'huîtres se vend entre 6 et 10 euros... La douzaine d'huîtres creuses calibre n°3 se vend entre 6 et 8 €... pour des produits d'exception comme les huîtres plates (Belon) ou des sélections spéciales (Tsarskaya), les prix s'ajustent à la rareté

claim: The GR34 coastal hike from Cancale to Pointe du Grouin runs about 7 km one-way along clifftop paths, taking roughly 3 hours with moderate up-and-down terrain.
quote: GR®34 Cancale – Pointe du Grouin, Ille-et-Vilaine, France

claim: Pointe du Grouin offers panoramas of Mont-Saint-Michel on clear days, hosts WWII blockhouses near the semaphore, and overlooks Île des Landes (~8 hectares) where cormorants and seabirds nest; grey seals occasionally rest on offshore rocks.
quote: Sur l'île des Landes, grands cormorans et goélands marins nichent paisiblement sur les parois rocheuses... environ 8 hectares... d'anciens blockhaus situés à proximité du sémaphore actuel

claim: Compagnie Corsaire's 2h30 commented cruise (boarding Saint-Malo 10:30 or Dinard 10:45, no disembarkation in Cancale) passes the Île des Landes bird sanctuary and Pointe du Grouin; adults €37, children 3-15 €24.40, under-3s €10.
quote: Durée 2h30... Saint-Malo 10:30... Dinard 10:45... Adulte 37€ Enfant (3-15 ans) 24,40€ Bébé (-3 ans) 10€

claim: Île des Landes is France's oldest biological nature reserve, founded in 1958 by SEPNB, and remains inaccessible to land visitors to protect nesting seabirds.
quote: L'île des Landes : l'Éden des oiseaux

claim: Le Coquillage in Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes earned its third Michelin star in the 2025 guide under Hugo Roellinger, having held two stars since 2019.
quote: Le Coquillage, la perle rare de Cancale, nouveau trois-Étoiles

claim: Olivier Roellinger did not sell the business; he retired from active kitchen duties in 2008 for health reasons and Hugo Roellinger has run Le Coquillage's kitchen since 2014, while sister Mathilde took over Épices Roellinger in 2018.
quote: Since 2014, Hugo has been elaborating his own cuisine with his crew at Coquillage... Olivier retired from active kitchen duties in 2008 for health reasons

claim: Grain de Vanille, the family's pastry shop-tea room at 12 place de la Victoire in upper Cancale, opens 9am-6:30pm continuously, closed Tuesdays, run by Yannick and Fernanda Gauthier since 2001 and selling Galettes Cancalaises, kouign-amann, ice creams and Roellinger spiced chocolates.
quote: Depuis 2001, Yannick et Fernanda Gauthier... 12, place de la Victoire 35260 CANCALE... ouvert en continu de 9h à 18h30, fermé le mardi

claim: Épices Roellinger's Cancale shop sits inside the Maison du Voyageur at 1 rue Duguesclin, doubling as the family's spice research and blending lab, with sister boutiques in Saint-Malo (12 rue Saint-Vincent) and Paris (51 bis rue Sainte-Anne).
quote: 1, rue Duguesclin – 35260 Cancale... Exotic scents waft through the kitchen lab, where spices from all over the world are roasted, oven-dried, ground, and then packaged

claim: The Maisons de Bricourt portfolio in Cancale also includes Les Rimains (clifftop 4-room hotel) and Gîtes Marins at 62 rue des Rimains, Le Bistrot de Cancale above Port Mer beach (opened June 2022), and La Cuisine Corsaire École cooking school on Place Saint-Méen.
quote: Les Rimains (62 rue des Rimains)... Le Bistrot de Cancale (5 Rue Eugène et Auguste Feyen) — New restaurant opened June 2022... La Cuisine Corsaire École (Place Saint-Méen)

claim: Driving distance from Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes to Mont-Saint-Michel is roughly 45 km, about 47 minutes via N176 and D4.
quote: The driving distance from Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes to Mont-Saint-Michel is approximately 45 kilometers, taking about 47 minutes. The route is primarily via N 176 and D 4.

claim: Mont-Saint-Michel Abbey 2026 entry is €16 from 1 April–30 September and €13 from 1 October–31 March; free for under-18s and EU residents aged 18–25.
quote: April 1 – September 30: Individual ticket: €16 ... October 1 – March 31: Individual ticket: €13 ... Free Admission: Children under 18 (families only); Ages 18-25 from EU countries

claim: La Caserne parking (mid-season Mar–Jun) costs €16 for 3h, €19 for 6h, €22 for 24h in 2026; first 30 minutes free.
quote: Mid Season (Mar 1-Jun 30 & Sep 1-Nov 1): Light vehicle up to 3h: €16; Light vehicle up to 6h: €19; Light vehicle 24h: €22. Free first 30 minutes year-round.

claim: La Caserne parking sits in Beauvoir 2.5 km from the abbey with ~4,000 spaces; the walking alternative along the pedestrian causeway takes 35–45 minutes.
quote: Located in Beauvoir ... approximately 4,000 spaces situated 2.5 kilometers from the abbey ... Distance: 2.5 kilometers via pedestrian walkway; Time Required: 35 to 45 minutes to reach the main abbey entrance

claim: April 18, 2026 is the highest spring tide of the year at the Mont with coefficient 105 (high tide 08:35), with neighbouring days April 17 (101), 19 (104), 20 (99).
quote: April 18 (highest of the year): Coefficient 105, high tide at 08:35; April 17: Coefficient 101, high tide at 07:55; April 19: Coefficient 104, high tide at 09:15; April 20: Coefficient 99, high tide at 09:55

claim: June 2026 peaks at coefficient 95 on the 16th (with 93 on the 15th and 94 on the 17th) — borderline spring tide, well below the island-flooding 110 threshold.
quote: June 16, 2026: Coefficient 95 (the month's highest) ... June 15 (coefficient 93) and June 17 (coefficient 94)

claim: A coefficient of about 110 is required for the sea to fully surround the Mount and flood the causeway, turning it back into an island.
quote: At a coefficient of 110, the Mont-Saint-Michel becomes an island again.

claim: Compagnie Corsaire runs the Saint-Malo to Dinard sea bus from 28 March to 3 July 2026; crossing takes 10 minutes; one-way adult €6.30 (rate A) and return €8.90; child one-way €4.50.
quote: Seabus Saint-Malo Dinard 28 march to 3rd july 2026 ... In the space of 10 minutes, you will be in Dinard or Saint-Malo. Adult return: €8.90 | One-way: €6.30. Child return: €6.30 | One-way: €4.50.

claim: Official 2026 sea bus spring timetable is published as a downloadable PDF on the Compagnie Corsaire schedules page.
quote: please find below our timetable Saint-Malo/Dinard from 28th march to 3rd july

claim: The Promenade du Clair de Lune hugs the Rance estuary with sea-spray-wet sections and panoramic views to Saint-Malo's ramparts; visitors describe a 15-minute walk to the casino.
quote: You are virtually on top of the sea which u can see/hear crashing up against the rocks ... On the other side of the Rance, you can see the ramparts of Saint Malo ... It takes about 15 minutes to walk and you'll arrive at the casino

claim: The Alfred Hitchcock bronze stands on the embankment of Plage de l'Écluse next to the casino, with birds on his shoulder referencing The Birds, commemorating Dinard's British Film Festival.
quote: On the embankment of Plage de l'Ecluse, next to the Casino you walk almost past the bronze monument ... Pictured here with birds on his shoulder. The Birds!

claim: Plage de l'Écluse is a broad southwest-facing crescent of golden sand with blue-and-white striped tents fixed since the 1890s, a seawater pool, and Dinard is dubbed 'Cannes of the North'.
quote: the famous blue-and-white striped tents that line the promenade ... have been a fixture since the 1890s ... sometimes dubbed the 'Cannes of the North'

claim: Dinard's 'Cannes of the North' reputation grew from late-19th-century American and British aristocrats building villas on the cliff tops; it remains 'one of the most British' French coastal resorts and hosts the Dinard British Film Festival (founded 1989).
quote: Dinard's reputation as the 'Cannes of the North' has attracted a wide variety of stars ... In the late 19th century, American and British aristocrats made Dinard a fashionable summer resort and built stunning villas on the cliff tops

claim: Dinard preserves nearly 400 protected Belle Époque villas accessible via the tourist office's walking tours, with Villa les Roches Brunes classified as a Historical Monument.
quote: nearly 400 protected villas to discover by following our walking tours ... Villa les Roches Brunes ... Classified as a Historical Monument

claim: Villa Eugénie (the former Musée du Site Balnéaire) is being converted into inclusive housing by the Diadème association under a 40-year lease signed 27 November 2025, with work starting in 2026 — meaning the museum is not operating in 2026.
quote: Les travaux de réhabilitation débuteront en 2026 ... une ouverture prévisionnelle en avril 2027

claim: The City of Dinard confirms Villa Eugénie's rehabilitation will deliver six inclusive-housing units and a solidarity restaurant, with provisional reopening April 2027.
quote: Les travaux débuteront prochainement pour une ouverture prévisionnelle en avril 2027.

claim: Saint-Lunaire and Saint-Briac-sur-Mer, west of Dinard, are quieter family seaside resorts with turquoise waters, fine sandy beaches, and Belle Époque villas — Saint-Lunaire's centre shaped by Haitian businessman Sylla Laraque.
quote: Saint-Lunaire's town center bears the radiance of the Belle Époque and reflects the passion of Sylla Laraque, a wealthy Haitian businessman who made Saint-Lunaire one of the first seaside resorts on the Emerald Coast

claim: Sea water at Plage de l'Écluse in May–June ranges roughly 12–18°C; a wetsuit is recommended for comfortable swimming.
quote: The sea at Plage de l'Écluse - Dinard feels cool so don't forget to pack your wetsuit

claim: Cap Fréhel sits roughly 45 km / ~52 minutes by road from Saint-Malo, putting it (and adjacent Fort la Latte) outside a strict 30-km radius from Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes.
quote: 44.9 km ... 52 minutes

claim: The Promenade du Clair de Lune is lined with palm trees, mimosas and agapanthus giving it an 'almost Mediterranean feel', and Dinard has hosted a British/Irish cinema festival every autumn since 1990.
quote: Palm trees, mimosas, and agapanthus line this pedestrian path, giving it an almost Mediterranean feel ... Since 1990, Dinard has hosted an annual fall festival dedicated to British and Irish cinema.

claim: Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes to Dol-de-Bretagne is approximately 16 km by road, around 20 minutes by car.
quote: The distance between Dol-de-Bretagne and Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes is approximately 16 kilometers by road. It generally takes approximately 20 minutes to cover this distance by car.

claim: The Menhir du Champ-Dolent stands 9.3–9.5 m above ground, is the second largest standing stone in Brittany, weighs about 100 tonnes, and sits 2 km south of Dol on the D795.
quote: height above ground is between 9.3 and 9.5 metres ... second largest standing stone in Brittany, made of pinkish granite ... estimated weight of around 100 tonnes ... 2 kilometres south of Dol-de-Bretagne ... near the D795 road.

claim: Legend says the Champ-Dolent menhir sprang from the earth to separate two warring brothers, hence 'Field of Sorrow'.
quote: According to legend, the menhir rose from the ground to separate two feuding brothers who were on the point of killing each other ... 'Champ Dolent' which means 'Field of Sorrow'.

claim: Cathédrale Saint-Samson was founded in the 6th century, rebuilt after a 1203 fire, and its choir window of 1280–1290 is the oldest monumental stained glass in Brittany still in situ.
quote: founded in the sixth century by Saint Samson, a Welsh monk ... rebuilt after the fire of 1203 ... The main window of the choir, dating from the years 1280-1290, is the oldest monumental stained glass window in Brittany still preserved in situ.

claim: The Cathédraloscope at 4 place de la cathédrale, Dol-de-Bretagne charges €8.50 adult (audio guide included), €6.50 for 6–18, free under 6, and €26 for a 2-adult+2-child family pass.
quote: Adults: €8.50 (includes €2.00 audio guide); Children (6-18 years): €6.50; Children under 6: Free; Family package (2 adults + 2 children): €26.00

claim: Cathédraloscope opens daily 10:00–13:00 / 14:00–18:00 from 1 April; July–August daily 10:00–18:30; stone-carving workshops Tue/Wed/Thu from 9 July.
quote: From April 1st: Daily 10am-1pm / 2pm-6pm. July/August: Daily 10am-6:30pm ... Stone carving workshops are open from July 9th, on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays at 2pm, 3:30pm and 5pm.

claim: Château de Combourg reopens 1 April 2026; tickets €13.70 adult, €10.70 reduced, €5.70 ages 5–12 (château + park); park-only €4.70; 45-minute guided interior tour.
quote: Réouverture du château le 1er avril 2026! ... Adults: €13.70 ... Children (5-12 years): €5.70 ... Reduced rate: €10.70 ... Park Access Only: Adults: €4.70 ... Guided Tour Duration: 45 minutes

claim: Combourg is closed Saturdays all day and Sunday mornings outside school holidays; François-René de Chateaubriand spent his childhood here and immortalised it in 'Mémoires d'Outre-Tombe'.
quote: closed on Saturday all day and Sunday morning except during school holidays and bridge weekends ... François-René de Chateaubriand spent his childhood here and immortalized it in his 'Mémoires d'Outre-Tombe'.

claim: Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes to Combourg is roughly 33.8 km / 37 minutes via D73 and D76 (other sources give ~28 km).
quote: The drive from Combourg to Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes takes 37 minutes for a distance of 33.8 kilometers. The route is mainly via D 73 and D 76.

claim: Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes to Dinan is about 30.8 km, 29 minutes by car via N176 and D76.
quote: Distance: The distance to travel is calculated at 30.8 kilometres. Driving Time: ... 29 minutes. Route: ... mainly via N 176 and D 76.

claim: Dinan is encircled by nearly 3 km of ramparts, has a 14th-century château over the Rance, and harbours more than 130 half-timbered houses.
quote: Dinan is enclosed by nearly three kilometres of ramparts, and its 14th-century castle proudly overlooks the Rance river ... home to over 130 half-timbered houses.

claim: Place des Merciers is the heart of Dinan's historic centre, lined with half-timbered houses with ground-floor wooden porches, and a walk beyond the walls leads down to the old port on the Rance.
quote: The heart of Dinan's historic center is Place des Merciers, still lined with picturesque half-timbered buildings, many sporting ground-floor wooden porches ... A short walk beyond the walls leads down to the river and the city's once-thriving old port.

claim: Mont-Dol summit (65 m) offers a panorama over the Bay of Mont-Saint-Michel and the Dol marshes; the Tour Notre-Dame (blessed 1857) can be climbed and a Chapelle de l'Espérance sits at its base.
quote: Mont-Dol offers one of the most beautiful panoramas ... at an altitude of 65 metres ... The Tour Notre-Dame was blessed in 1857, and you can climb to the top of this tower ... Chapelle de l'Espérance with its small stone campanile

claim: Corsaires Malouins runs a full-day sea-kayak tour 'Dans le sillage des Corsaires' from Saint-Malo to Île de Cézembre and the Grand Jardin lighthouse, 6 hours total with ~4.5 hours on the water, €90 per person (age 14+), departing from Bon-Secours Beach Intra-Muros or Port-Picain Cancale.
quote: Dans le sillage des Corsaires... De l'île de Cézembre au pied du phare du Grand Jardin, une journée à la conquête des joyaux de la baie... 90€/personne... 6 heures (dont 4h30 sur l'eau)

claim: Char en Baie at 1 rue de la Plage, Cherrueix offers 1.5-hour discovery sand-yachting sessions at €34/person, €32/person for 4-7 people and €30/person for 8+, year-round every afternoon, age 8+, helmet/insurance/equipment included.
quote: Séance de découverte individuelle (1h30): 34,00€ par personne, 32,00€ par personne (4-7 personnes), 30,00€ par personne (8 personnes et +)... tous les après-midi, à l'année

claim: The Vélomaritime (EuroVelo 4) from Mont-Saint-Michel to Saint-Malo is 68 km along the Breton coast, split into Saint-Malo–Cancale 18 km, Cancale–Le Vivier-sur-Mer 21 km and Le Vivier–Mont-Saint-Michel 29 km.
quote: From Mont-St-Michel to St Malo by bike: 68 km along the coast... Saint-Malo / Cancale: 18 km... Cancale / Le Vivier-sur-Mer: 21 km... Le Vivier-sur-Mer / Mont-Saint-Michel: 29 km

claim: La Ferme Marine de Cancale (Route de la Corniche, L'Aurore) runs 1-hour guided oyster-farming tours at €9.70 adult, €5.70 child 7-15, €28 family (2A+2C); French daily Mon-Fri 3pm Feb 16-late October, with summer 2026 (6 July-29 Aug) adding 14:00 English and 16:00 German tours.
quote: Tarifs: 9,70€ adultes, 5,70€ enfants 7-15 ans, 28€ famille 2 adultes+2 enfants... visites en français du lundi au vendredi à 15h... été 2026: 14h visite en anglais, 16h visite en allemand

claim: Maison de la Baie at Le Vivier-sur-Mer offers the Mytili-mobile mussel-farm outing — a tractor-pulled trailer onto the bay flats — for 2 hours at €14 adult and €9.50 child 6-14, with a free permanent AOP mussel exhibition.
quote: La sortie mytili-mobile (2 heures): 14€ par adulte, 9,50€ par enfant (6-14 ans)... remorque tractée par un tracteur

claim: Vélo Émeraude (5 Rue d'Aleth, Saint-Malo / warehouse La Gouesnière) is an appointment-only bike rental with delivery to hotels, campsites and Vélomaritime trailheads; delivery from 2 bikes costs €5 round-trip for the first bike then €2.50 per additional bike.
quote: à partir de 2 vélos: 5€ aller-retour pour le premier vélo, puis 2,50€ par vélo supplémentaire... livraison depuis l'entrepôt de La Gouesnière

claim: SNBSM (Société Nautique de la Baie de Saint-Malo) is the French Sailing Federation–affiliated école française de voile in Saint-Malo offering sailing lessons from age 6 in Optimist, dinghies, catamarans, windsurfers and keelboats (15+) during Easter, summer and All Saints holidays.
quote: École de sport voile légère... à partir de 6 ans... Optimist, dériveurs, catamarans, planches à voile et habitable à partir de 15 ans

claim: Centre Nautique de Cancale on Plage de Port-Mer, founded 1977 and French Sailing Federation–certified, runs year-round Optimist (7-10), RS Zest dinghy, Hobie catamaran and cruising-sailboat classes plus week-long summer stages with online booking.
quote: Centre Nautique de Cancale... Plage de Port-Mer, 35260 Cancale... Optimist (7-10 ans), dériveurs RS Zest, catamarans Hobie, habitables croisière... stages saisonniers

claim: Surfschool Saint-Malo on Plage du Sillon (2 Avenue de la Hoguette) is FFV-certified with state-diplomaed instructors, teaching surf, catamaran, windsurf and char à voile from age 3 (sea school 6-12, teens/adults 9+).
quote: Située sur la grande plage du Sillon à Saint-Malo... agréé par la Fédération Française de Voile... catamaran, planche à voile, char à voile, surf... à partir de 3 ans

claim: The GR34 'Sentier des Douaniers' is a marked long-distance walker-only coastal footpath using clifftop paths, rock-cut stairs and beach passages — many sections impassable by bike — distinct from the parallel Vélomaritime cycle route that runs on secured roads and shared paths.
quote: Le GR34, sentier des douaniers... chemin pédestre balisé... petits sentiers côtiers, escaliers taillés dans la roche, passages sur plages... impraticable à vélo sur de nombreuses sections

claim: Cycles Nicole at 11 rue Prés Robert Schuman, Saint-Malo (29 years in business, +33 2 99 56 11 06) sells and rents bikes, e-bikes and 50/125cc scooters and is an authorised Bosch e-bike dealer.
quote: Cycles Nicole... 11 rue Prés Robert Schuman Saint Malo 35400... vélos électriques, scooters, vente, réparation multimarque, location... revendeur agréé Bosch

claim: Le Passeur free shuttle runs daily from 7:30 AM to midnight, departing roughly every 12 minutes.
quote: The shuttle runs every day from 7:30 AM until midnight, departing approximately every 12 minutes.

claim: Le Passeur drops off passengers about 350 m before the entrance to Mont-Saint-Michel village; off-hours service is available on demand at +33 (0)2 14 13 20 15.
quote: shuttle runs at least from 7.30 am to 11 pm... just 350 m before the entrance to the village of Mont Saint-Michel... +33 (0)2 14 13 20 15

claim: The Passeur shuttle takes about 12 minutes to reach the Mont from the mainland parking, versus a 40-50 minute walk.
quote: takes about 12 minutes to reach the Mont... walking paths from the parking area to Mont Saint-Michel take approximately 40-50 minutes

claim: The Abbey is open daily 09:00–19:00 from 1 May to 31 August 2026, with last admission one hour before closing; exceptionally closed on 1 June 2026.
quote: Open daily from 09:00 to 19:00... final admission occurs one hour before closing time... Additionally, June 1, 2026 has an exceptional closure scheduled.

claim: May 2026 spring-tide peak in the bay runs 16–19 May with coefficients 92/96 (16th), 98/99 (17th), 99/97 (18th), 95/91 (19th); peak coefficient is 99 on 17–18 May.
Across 2026, only one May date (17 May) sees a tide coefficient above 95 at Mont-Saint-Michel, between April's 18th and June's 16th.
quote: May: 17 ... dates des marées en 2026 dont les coefficients de marée dépassent les 95
